vwap_definition: RTH-only session VWAP; reset each trade date; typical price (H+L+C)/3 weighted by 1m volume; completed bars only.
leakage_guard: Every field uses bars timestamp <= decision timestamp only.
note: This patch captures contemporaneous VWAP state/path. Reclaim-after-loss and loss-after-full-clear flags are intentionally deferred to analysis by joining certified event/decision chronology, avoiding ambiguous event-level future summaries in the enrichment.
